Frequently asked questions
Everything you need to know about child sponsorship
How much does sponsorship cost?

Sponsorship starts at $25 per month. You choose the amount that fits your budget. Your gifts fund the meals, medical care and education programs that reach every child in our care. In fiscal 2025, 95% of funds went directly to programs.
Where does my money go?

Your sponsorship funds provide weekly meals, medical checkups twice a year, school supplies and uniforms, and faith-based teaching. We maintain complete transparency about how every dollar is spent. You can review our detailed financials anytime on our website.
Can I write to my sponsored child?
Yes. Your child will receive your letters and drawings, and they will write back to you. This connection is one of the most meaningful parts of sponsorship.
What updates will I receive?

You'll receive letters and photos from your child, along with annual impact reports showing how your sponsorship changed their life. We also send prayer requests and updates about their progress in school and health.
Can I send gifts to my child?

We recommend keeping gifts modest and practical, such as school supplies or books. Large or expensive gifts can create complications. We'll guide you on what works best for your child's situation and community.
Does my money go directly to my sponsored child?

Your sponsorship connects you with one child. Gifts are combined to fund the nutrition, medical care and education that reach every child in our programs, which keeps support steady for each child even if a sponsor steps away.
What if I need to cancel?

You can pause or end your sponsorship anytime with no penalty. We ask for thirty days' notice so we can help transition your child to another sponsor. Your child's care continues uninterrupted during this time.
Still have questions?
